datasets.name: weather_gold
queryLines:
SELECT
  w.forecast_date,
  w.location_id,
  w.city_name,
  w.min_temp_c,
  w.max_temp_c,
  w.avg_temp_c,
  w.min_humidity_pct,
  w.max_humidity_pct,
  w.avg_humidity_pct,
  w.total_precipitation_mm,
  w.max_wind_speed_kmh,
  w.weather_alert,
  w.updated_at,
  dl.department AS department,
  CASE
    WHEN
      (
        w.max_temp_c < 35
        OR w.avg_humidity_pct < 80
      )
      AND w.max_wind_speed_kmh < 50
      AND w.total_precipitation_mm >= 20
    THEN
      1
    ELSE 0
  END AS rainy_day,
  CASE
    WHEN
      w.weather_alert IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(w.weather_alert) <> ''
    THEN
      1
    ELSE 0
  END AS alert_count,
  CASE
    WHEN w.max_temp_c >= 35 THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END AS heat_day,
  CASE
    WHEN w.total_precipitation_mm >= 10 THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END AS heavy_rain_day,
  CASE
    WHEN w.max_wind_speed_kmh >= 50 THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END AS high_wind_day,
  CASE
    WHEN
      w.avg_temp_c BETWEEN -50 AND 60
      AND w.avg_humidity_pct BETWEEN 0 AND 100
      AND w.total_precipitation_mm >= 0
    THEN
      1
    ELSE 0
  END AS dq_pass
FROM
  gold.daily_weather_summary w
    LEFT JOIN config.department_locations dl
      ON w.location_id = dl.location_id
      AND COALESCE(:department, 'All') <> 'All'
      AND dl.department = :department
WHERE
  w.forecast_date BETWEEN :start_date AND :end_date
  AND (
    (
      current_user() = 'srikanth.449@gmail.com'
      AND (
        COALESCE(:department, 'All') = 'All'
        OR w.location_id IN (
          SELECT dl2.location_id
          FROM config.department_locations dl2
          WHERE dl2.department = :department
        )
      )
    )
    OR (
      current_user() <> 'srikanth.449@gmail.com'
      AND w.location_id IN (
        SELECT l.location_id
        FROM config.locations l
        WHERE COALESCE(:department, 'All') = 'All'
          OR l.location_id IN (
            SELECT dl2.location_id
            FROM config.department_locations dl2
            WHERE dl2.department = :department
          )
      )
    )
  )
  AND (
    COALESCE(:city_name, 'All') = 'All'
    OR w.city_name = :city_name
  )
  AND (
    COALESCE(:location_id, 'All') = 'All'
    OR w.location_id = :location_id

columns.description: Percentage of gold rows passing all range validations (temperature -50 to 60 C, humidity 0-100 pct, precipitation >= 0).

datasets.name: pipeline_runs
queryLines:
SELECT
  run_id,
  start_time,
  end_time,
  status,
  parameters,
  locations_attempted,
  locations_succeeded,
  silver_rows_merged,
  quarantined_rows,
  error_message,
  CASE
    WHEN LOWER(status) LIKE 'succ%' THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END AS run_success,
  CASE
    WHEN LOWER(status) NOT LIKE 'succ%' THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END AS run_failed,
  ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(end_time) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(start_time)) / 60.0, 1) AS duration_minutes,
  CAST(start_time AS DATE) AS run_date
FROM
  audit.pipeline_runs
ORDER BY
  start_time DESC

datasets.name: data_health
queryLines:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT
    (
      SELECT
        MAX(end_time)
      FROM
        audit.pipeline_runs
    ) AS last_run_time,
    (
      SELECT
        COUNT(*)
      FROM
        audit.pipeline_runs
    ) AS total_runs,
    (
      SELECT
        SUM(
          CASE
            WHEN LOWER(status) LIKE 'succ%' THEN 1
            ELSE 0
          END
        )
      FROM
        audit.pipeline_runs
    ) AS successful_runs,
    (
      SELECT
        SUM(
          CASE
            WHEN LOWER(status) NOT LIKE 'succ%' THEN 1
            ELSE 0
          END
        )
      FROM
        audit.pipeline_runs
    ) AS failed_runs,
    (
      SELECT
        COALESCE(SUM(silver_rows_merged), 0)
      FROM
        audit.pipeline_runs
    ) AS rows_loaded,
    (
      SELECT
        COALESCE(SUM(quarantined_rows), 0)
      FROM
        audit.pipeline_runs
    ) AS rows_rejected,
    (
      SELECT
        COUNT(*)
      FROM
        quarantine.weather_quarantine
    ) AS quarantine_count,
    (
      SELECT
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(current_timestamp()) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(updated_at))) / 3600.0, 1)
      FROM
        gold.daily_weather_summary
    ) AS freshness_hours,
    (
      SELECT
        MAX(updated_at)
      FROM
        gold.daily_weather_summary
    ) AS last_refresh_time
)
SELECT
  s.*,
  ROUND(s.successful_runs * 100.0 / NULLIF(s.total_runs, 0), 1) AS success_rate_pct,
  ROUND(s.failed_runs * 100.0 / NULLIF(s.total_runs, 0), 1) AS failure_rate_pct,
  CASE
    WHEN s.freshness_hours <= 24 THEN 'Fresh'
    ELSE 'Stale'
  END AS freshness_status
FROM
  s

datasets.name: dq_checks
queryLines:
WITH silver_window AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM
    silver.weather_hourly
  WHERE
    CAST(forecast_ts AS DATE) BETWEEN :start_date AND :end_date
    AND (
      COALESCE(:city_name, 'All') = 'All'
      OR city_name = :city_name
    )
    AND (
      COALESCE(:location_id, 'All') = 'All'
      OR location_id = :location_id
    )
),
gold_window AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM
    gold.daily_weather_summary
  WHERE
    forecast_date BETWEEN :start_date AND :end_date
    AND (
      COALESCE(:city_name, 'All') = 'All'
      OR city_name = :city_name
    )
    AND (
      COALESCE(:location_id, 'All') = 'All'
      OR location_id = :location_id
    )
),
duplicate_silver_keys AS (
  SELECT
    location_id,
    forecast_ts
  FROM
    silver_window
  GROUP BY
    location_id,
    forecast_ts
  HAVING
    COUNT(*) > 1
),
duplicate_gold_keys AS (
  SELECT
    forecast_date,
    location_id
  FROM
    gold_window
  GROUP BY
    forecast_date,
    location_id
  HAVING
    COUNT(*) > 1
),
checks AS (
  SELECT
    'Null Checks' AS check_category,
    'Null temperature_2m' AS check_name,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN temperature_2m IS NULL THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS violations,
    COUNT(*) AS rows_checked,
    'NULL temperature_2m values in silver.weather_hourly' AS details
  FROM
    silver_window
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'Null Checks',
    'Null relative_humidity_2m',
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN relative_humidity_2m IS NULL THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ),
    COUNT(*),
    'NULL relative_humidity_2m values in silver.weather_hourly'
  FROM
    silver_window
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'Null Checks',
    'Null precipitation',
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN precipitation IS NULL THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ),
    COUNT(*),
    'NULL precipitation values in silver.weather_hourly'
  FROM
    silver_window
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'Null Checks',
    'Null wind_speed_10m',
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN wind_speed_10m IS NULL THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ),
    COUNT(*),
    'NULL wind_speed_10m values in silver.weather_hourly'
  FROM
    silver_window
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'Duplicate Checks',
    'Duplicate (location_id, forecast_ts) in silver',
    COUNT(*),
    (
      SELECT
        COUNT(*)
      FROM
        silver_window
    ),
    'Silver rows in duplicated (location_id, forecast_ts) key groups'
  FROM
    silver_window s
      JOIN duplicate_silver_keys d
        ON s.location_id = d.location_id
        AND s.forecast_ts = d.forecast_ts
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'Duplicate Checks',
    'Duplicate (forecast_date, location_id) in gold',
    COUNT(*),
    (
      SELECT
        COUNT(*)
      FROM
        gold_window
    ),
    'Gold rows in duplicated (forecast_date, location_id) key groups'
  FROM
    gold_window g
      JOIN duplicate_gold_keys d
        ON g.forecast_date = d.forecast_date
        AND g.location_id = d.location_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'Range Validation',
    'Temperature within -50 to 60 C',
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN
          avg_temp_c < -50
          OR avg_temp_c > 60
        THEN
          1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ),
    COUNT(*),
    'Gold avg_temp_c values outside valid range'
  FROM
    gold_window
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'Range Validation',
    'Humidity within 0 to 100 pct',
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN
          avg_humidity_pct < 0
          OR avg_humidity_pct > 100
        THEN
          1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ),
    COUNT(*),
    'Gold avg_humidity_pct values outside valid range'
  FROM
    gold_window
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'Range Validation',
    'Precipitation within 0 to 500 mm',
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN
          total_precipitation_mm < 0
          OR total_precipitation_mm > 500
        THEN
          1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ),
    COUNT(*),
    'Gold total_precipitation_mm values outside valid range'
  FROM
    gold_window
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'Freshness Validation',
    'Latest silver forecast within 48 hours',
    CASE
      WHEN f.hours_since_latest_forecast > 48 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END,
    1,
    CONCAT(
      'Hours since latest silver forecast: ',
      CAST(f.hours_since_latest_forecast AS STRING),
      ' (threshold: 48h)'
    )
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        ROUND(
          (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(current_timestamp()) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(forecast_ts))) / 3600.0,
          1
        ) AS hours_since_latest_forecast
      FROM
        silver_window
    ) f
)
SELECT
  check_category,
  check_name,
  CAST(violations AS BIGINT) AS violations,
  CAST(rows_checked AS BIGINT) AS rows_checked,
  details
FROM
  checks
ORDER BY
  check_category,
  check_name

columns.description: Data quality check result: PASS when no violations, otherwise FAIL.
columns.expression: CASE WHEN violations = 0 THEN 'PASS' ELSE 'FAIL' END

datasets.name: geo_weather
queryLines:
SELECT
  l.city_name,
  l.country,
  l.latitude,
  l.longitude,
  ROUND(AVG(g.avg_temp_c), 1) AS avg_temp_c,
  ROUND(SUM(g.total_precipitation_mm), 1) AS total_precipitation_mm,
  ROUND(MAX(g.max_wind_speed_kmh), 1) AS max_wind_speed_kmh,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN
        g.weather_alert IS NOT NULL
        AND TRIM(g.weather_alert) <> ''
      THEN
        1
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS alert_count
FROM
  config.locations l
    INNER JOIN gold.daily_weather_summary g
      ON l.location_id = g.location_id
WHERE
  g.forecast_date BETWEEN :start_date AND :end_date
  AND (
    COALESCE(:city_name, 'All') = 'All'
    OR g.city_name = :city_name
  )
  AND (
    COALESCE(:location_id, 'All') = 'All'
    OR g.location_id = :location_id
  )
GROUP BY
  l.city_name,
  l.country,
  l.latitude,
  l.longitude
ORDER BY
  l.city_name

datasets.name: severe_conditions
queryLines:
WITH gold_window AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM
    gold.daily_weather_summary
  WHERE
    forecast_date BETWEEN :start_date AND :end_date
    AND (
      COALESCE(:city_name, 'All') = 'All'
      OR city_name = :city_name
    )    AND (
      COALESCE(:location_id, 'All') = 'All'
      OR location_id = :location_id
    )
    AND (
      (
        current_user() = 'srikanth.449@gmail.com'
        AND (
          COALESCE(:department, 'All') = 'All'
          OR location_id IN (
            SELECT dl2.location_id
            FROM config.department_locations dl2
            WHERE dl2.department = :department
          )
        )
      )
      OR (
        current_user() <> 'srikanth.449@gmail.com'
        AND location_id IN (
          SELECT l.location_id
          FROM config.locations l
          WHERE COALESCE(:department, 'All') = 'All'
            OR l.location_id IN (
              SELECT dl2.location_id
              FROM config.department_locations dl2
              WHERE dl2.department = :department
            )
        )
      )
    )
  )
SELECT
  'High Wind Days (max wind >= 50 km/h)' AS condition,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN
        (max_temp_c < 35 OR avg_humidity_pct < 80)
        AND max_wind_speed_kmh >= 50
      THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS day_count
FROM
  gold_window
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Extreme Heat Days (max temp >= 35 C, humidity >= 80%)',
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN
        max_temp_c >= 35
        AND avg_humidity_pct >= 80
      THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END
  )
FROM
  gold_window
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Heavy Rain Days (precip >= 20 mm)',
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN
        (max_temp_c < 35 OR avg_humidity_pct < 80)
        AND max_wind_speed_kmh < 50
        AND total_precipitation_mm >= 20
      THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END
  )
FROM
  gold_window
ORDER BY
  day_count DESC

columns.description: Severity of severe condition days: OK when no days, CRITICAL for heavy rain, WARN for heat/wind.
columns.expression: CASE WHEN day_count = 0 THEN 'OK' WHEN condition LIKE 'Heavy Rain%' THEN 'CRITICAL' ELSE 'WARN' END
